description_html:
A well preserved and highly sought after small style studio (Type F1A) set within the iconic Barbican Estate. Much of the apartments original features have been retained, from the yacht-inspired Brooke Marine kitchen to the built-in cupboard and white tiled bathroom.
The floor to ceiling sliding window floods the apartment with light and opens onto a balcony perfectly positioned to catch the evening sun. Extended Lease.

Residents benefit from access to private gardens, underground car parking with 24-7 porterage, storage cages, cycle parking, tennis court (fee applies) and collection of refuse and re-cycling from your door.
Ideally located for access to the Barbican Arts centre and the local amenities of Clerkenwell. There is a Tesco express and Waitrose supermarket nearby and One New Change shopping centre is a short walk away.

The Barbican Arts Centre has its own concert hall, cinema screens, theatre, galleries, library, shops bars and restaurants.

Managed by the City of London Corporation, the Barbican Estate is the finest achievement of the
architects Chamberlin, Powell & Bon. It was Grade II listed in 2001 in recognition of its extraordinary contribution to London's urban landscape.

Excellent transport links with the underground and national rail services of Barbican, Farringdon, and Moorgate stations all within walking distance.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 170
Service Charge: £3,560 (Yearly)
Council Tax Band: C
